Package org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.model

Class ModifiableDnsEntry

java.lang.Object
org.bremersee.samba.ad.dc.model.ModifiableDnsEntry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, AdEntry, DistinguishedNameProvider, DnsEntry
@Generated(from="DnsEntry", generator="Modifiables") @Generated({"Modifiables.generator","DnsEntry"}) public final class ModifiableDnsEntry extends Object implements DnsEntry
A modifiable implementation of the DnsEntry type.

Use the create() static factory methods to create new instances. Use the toImmutable() method to convert to canonical immutable instances.

ModifiableDnsEntry is not thread-safe
